messages:
Ava (PM): quick sync: need to finalize onboarding gates + pilot acceptance for the Optimize toolkit (batching, caching, quant recs, eval alerts). VaultAI and ClearDocs pilot requests are blocking our beta.
Ravi (Eng): agree. We should keep initial scope tight. Batching primitives + a minimal caching layer first. Quant recs are higher risk.
Sophie (ML): safety-first: eval-triggered alerts must be in place before any automatic quant recommendations are applied to customer traffic.
Ava (PM): draft launch gates: 1) cost delta >= 10% tokens/op on pilot workload OR clear cost/tradeoff documentation; 2) quality delta <= 3% on canonical eval for each use case; 3) canary rollout with automated rollback; 4) eval alerts live with sampling rules.
Diego (SRE): operational gates: rollback under 10 mins, error-rate change <0.1pp, circuit breaker tested, observability for cache evicts and batch sizes.
Carlos (Solutions): customers want revertable quant profiles and tenant-level TTL control for caches (PII-safe defaults). Also a 1-page runbook for on-call and customers.
Maya (ProdOps): onboarding checklist: sample prompt sets, token histograms, traffic replay for 24h, contact list for emergency rollback. Alpha needs internal traffic for 2 days with no critical regressions.
Ravi (Eng): config sketch for discussion: ```yaml
optimize:
  route: 'completion.write'
  batching: {max_batch: 48, target_ms: 100}
  cache: {mode: 'prefix', default_ttl_s: 300, pii_mode: 'disabled'}
  quant: {recommended: 'off', allowed_profiles: ['int8','int8-dynamic']}
  eval_alerts: {enabled: true, window_hours: 24, min_samples: 500}
```
Sophie (ML): add guidance: eval-alerting thresholds should be normalized by task metric variance; include drift detector and label-noise heuristic. Also require stable canonical eval sets per-customer.
Ava (PM): good. For beta gating: require two customer workloads (VaultAI + ClearDocs) running for 72h with no alerts above triage threshold, and a documented rollback executed in staging.
Diego (SRE): scheduling note: we need an engineer on-call during beta rollouts and a reserve capacity plan for model fallback.
Carlos (Solutions): I'll collect customer-specific constraints and produce the 1-page runbook templates.
Maya (ProdOps): will set kickoff with VaultAI and ClearDocs next Tue, will ask them to provide eval sets and traffic slices.
Ravi (Eng): prioritization proposal: 1) batching core + safe defaults 2) minimal eval-observability + alerting probe 3) caching with tenant TTL/tagging 4) quant recommendation engine (gradual, gated).
Sophie (ML): prefer moving eval-observability to step 2 so quant can't be promoted without it.
Ava (PM): compromise accepted. Quant out of initial beta unless offline sim shows <1% quality delta and eval-alerting is active.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: scheduled window requested for optimize-alpha at 1766720000.
Diego (SRE): confirm deploy window; will reserve rollback window and circuit-breaker tests.
Ava (PM): owners: Ravi - batching PR; Diego+Ravi - caching prototype; Sophie - eval-alert spec; Carlos - runbook; Maya - customer kickoff. Please create tickets in Optimize epic by Friday.
Carlos (Solutions): noted.
Sophie (ML): will share eval template and threshold examples.
Ava (PM): thanks all. If no objections Ill update roadmap doc and circulate the finalized gates. :thumbsup:
Diego (SRE): no objections.
Ravi (Eng): no objections.
InfraBot: note: thread archived to project Optimize after 7 days of inactivity.
